unsupported_or_rejected: Specific Geant4 cause of zero-deposit showers cannot be recovered from aggregate counts.
Nuclear interaction lengths and beam-axis identity cannot be inferred from a 1.57 m stored-centroid span without production materials and coordinate frame.
The 61.2338 GeV cap has no established ten-sigma margin from the available tail data.
Q=m-R does not prove purely lateral fragmentation or a causal fraction attributable to layer independence or Gumbel sampling.
The row split permits a C2ST bias, but memorization and the numerical cause of 0.464 have not been demonstrated.
Mean energy in fixed deep layers does not identify energy in additional late hits or guarantee threshold suppression.
No production calibration coefficients, reconstructed-energy shift, solver-only generation latency, or matched Geant4 speed benchmark are available.
A sequential layer model or spatial prior is a proposed controlled comparison, not a requirement proved by these aggregate results.
